def goodExpoMeasure(inRGB: Integer[Array, '16 16 16'], sigma: Float):
    bprobe_trace = []
    '\n    Compute the good exposition image quality measure on 1 input image.\n    '
    bprobe_v0 = inRGB[0, :, :]
    bprobe_trace.append((0, bprobe_v0))
    bprobe_v1 = bprobe_v0.astype(np.float64)
    bprobe_trace.append((1, bprobe_v1))
    R = bprobe_v1
    bprobe_v2 = inRGB[1, :, :]
    bprobe_trace.append((2, bprobe_v2))
    bprobe_v3 = bprobe_v2.astype(np.float64)
    bprobe_trace.append((3, bprobe_v3))
    G = bprobe_v3
    bprobe_v4 = inRGB[2, :, :]
    bprobe_trace.append((4, bprobe_v4))
    bprobe_v5 = bprobe_v4.astype(np.float64)
    bprobe_trace.append((5, bprobe_v5))
    B = bprobe_v5
    bprobe_v6 = R - 128
    bprobe_trace.append((10, bprobe_v6))
    bprobe_v7 = bprobe_v6 ** 2
    bprobe_trace.append((9, bprobe_v7))
    bprobe_v8 = -bprobe_v7
    bprobe_trace.append((7, bprobe_v8))
    bprobe_v9 = bprobe_v8 / sigma
    bprobe_trace.append((8, bprobe_v9))
    bprobe_v10 = np.exp(bprobe_v9)
    bprobe_trace.append((6, bprobe_v10))
    goodExpoR = bprobe_v10
    bprobe_v11 = G - 128
    bprobe_trace.append((15, bprobe_v11))
    bprobe_v12 = bprobe_v11 ** 2
    bprobe_trace.append((14, bprobe_v12))
    bprobe_v13 = -bprobe_v12
    bprobe_trace.append((12, bprobe_v13))
    bprobe_v14 = bprobe_v13 / sigma
    bprobe_trace.append((13, bprobe_v14))
    bprobe_v15 = np.exp(bprobe_v14)
    bprobe_trace.append((11, bprobe_v15))
    goodExpoG = bprobe_v15
    bprobe_v16 = B - 128
    bprobe_trace.append((20, bprobe_v16))
    bprobe_v17 = bprobe_v16 ** 2
    bprobe_trace.append((19, bprobe_v17))
    bprobe_v18 = -bprobe_v17
    bprobe_trace.append((17, bprobe_v18))
    bprobe_v19 = bprobe_v18 / sigma
    bprobe_trace.append((18, bprobe_v19))
    bprobe_v20 = np.exp(bprobe_v19)
    bprobe_trace.append((16, bprobe_v20))
    goodExpoB = bprobe_v20
    bprobe_v21 = goodExpoR * goodExpoG
    bprobe_trace.append((21, bprobe_v21))
    bprobe_v22 = bprobe_v21 * goodExpoB
    bprobe_trace.append((22, bprobe_v22))
    goodExpo = bprobe_v22
    bprobe_v23 = np.round(goodExpo, 2)
    bprobe_trace.append((24, bprobe_v23))
    bprobe_v24 = bprobe_v23 * (2 ** 8 - 1)
    bprobe_trace.append((25, bprobe_v24))
    bprobe_v25 = bprobe_v24.astype(np.uint8)
    bprobe_trace.append((23, bprobe_v25))
    goodExpo = bprobe_v25
    return bprobe_trace
